description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Query to web shops"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Availability, price and delivery time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryBatch" name="Parts delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsEmail" name="Email complaining about web shops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query all web shops"
                      sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Web shop offers"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"
                      messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Initial parts orders"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterBatch" name="Further parts batch"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_StartLaterBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestReorder" name="Order part from cheapest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestReorder" name="Order part from fastest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Parts needed for contract project">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Query_Offers</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive availability, price and delivery time from all shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Query_Offers</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Offers_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SufficientSupply" name="Can one shop supply the required parts?"
                           default="Flow_Supply_Split">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Offers_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Supply_OneShop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Supply_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateOneShop" name="Allocate parts to the cheapest shop that can supply them">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Supply_OneShop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OneShop_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateSeveralShops" name="Allocate parts across several shops using the cheapest parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Supply_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllocationMerge" name="Allocation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OneShop_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Lists</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Lists</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Lists_Orders</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrders" name="Order parts from the selected web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Lists_Orders</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Orders_FirstBatch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive the first parts batch">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Orders_FirstBatch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FirstBatch_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildAndStock" name="Build project and manage stock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FirstBatch_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_End</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Build" name="First parts batch received">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_StartTask</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildProject" name="Build project">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_StartTask</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_CheckFive</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowFive" name="Has stock for a single part fallen below 5?"
                             default="Flow_NotBelowFive">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_CheckFive</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowFive_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotBelowFive</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the part from the cheapest shop">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowFive_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cheapest_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeBelowFive" name="Below-five check complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cheapest_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotBelowFive</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeFive_CheckThree</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowThree" name="Has stock for a single part fallen below 3?"
                             default="Flow_NotBelowThree">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeFive_CheckThree</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowThree_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotBelowThree</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the part again from the fastest shop">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowThree_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fastest_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeBelowThree" name="Below-three check complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fastest_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotBelowThree</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeThree_CheckZero</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ZeroStock" name="Is stock for a single part zero?"
                             default="Flow_NotZero">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeThree_CheckZero</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotZero</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the web shops">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero_Email</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeZero" name="Zero-stock check complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotZero</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Build" name="Building and stock checks complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero_End</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_LaterBatches" name="Receive further parts batches" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartLaterBatch" name="Further parts batch arrives" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LaterBatch_Add</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_AddBatchToStock" name="Add received batch to stock">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LaterBatch_Add</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LaterBatch_End</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LaterBatch" name="Batch added to stock">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LaterBatch_End</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_Add" sourceRef="Event_StartLaterBatch" targetRef="Task_AddBatchToStock"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_End" sourceRef="Task_AddBatchToStock" targetRef="End_LaterBatch"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_StartTask" sourceRef="Start_Build" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_CheckFive" sourceRef="Task_BuildProject" targetRef="Gateway_BelowFive"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive_Reorder" name="Stock below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelowFive" name="Stock is at least 5" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBelowFive"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cheapest_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBelowFive"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeFive_CheckThree" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeBelowFive" targetRef="Gateway_BelowThree"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree_Reorder" name="Stock below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelowThree" name="Stock is at least 3" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBelowThree"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fastest_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBelowThree"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeThree_CheckZero" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeBelowThree" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroStock"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_Email" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroStock" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotZero" name="Stock is not zero" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroStock" targetRef="Gateway_MergeZero"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_End" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeZero"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_End" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeZero" targetRef="End_Build"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Contract" name="Contract project workflow complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Gateway_SufficientSupply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Supply_OneShop" name="One shop has sufficient parts" sourceRef="Gateway_SufficientSupply" targetRef="Task_AllocateOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">a shop can supply the required parts</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Supply_Split" name="No single shop has sufficient parts" sourceRef="Gateway_SufficientSupply" targetRef="Task_AllocateSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AllocateOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_AllocationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AllocateSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_AllocationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Lists" sourceRef="Gateway_AllocationMerge" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Orders" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orders_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_End" sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildAndStock" targetRef="End_Contract"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
